# Next.js

A TypeScript web app using **Next.js** and Robo.js.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://nextjs.org/" title="Next.js" description="The React Framework." />
  <Card href="/docs/web-apps" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template web-apps/next-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Next.js App Router
- Server Components
- TypeScript support
- API routes via Robo.js
